## Summary

Strategic sourcing manager with experience across semiconductor and electronics distribution, covering global sourcing strategy, supplier negotiation, and procurement process design. Track record of delivering cost savings, managing high-spend distributor relationships, and building the data frameworks that support sourcing decisions. Completing a Master of Science in Supply Chain Management with a concentration in Data Analytics.

## Experience

### Prodrive Technologies | May 2023 – Present

**Global Distribution Sourcing Manager** | Netherlands

- Own distribution sourcing strategy across four regions (USA, Netherlands, Malaysia, China), managing a \$120M annual spend package.
- Lead the design of a centralized distribution model consolidating four regional procurement groups into one function, capturing economies of scale and purchasing power.
- Define the operating model behind centralization: sourcing processes, decision rights, and regional stakeholder alignment.
- Manage strategic relationships with global distribution partners and negotiate global terms.
- Adapt sourcing strategy to AI-driven shifts in component availability, allocation, and pricing.
- Assess the effect of trade policy, export controls, and tariffs on sourcing decisions and supplier selection.
- Design sourcing KPIs grounded in how data moves through SAP and supplier systems, so reported performance reflects operations.

**Category Manager** | Boston, MA

- Managed more than $5 million in annual distribution spend, covering approximately 80% of US purchasing for production requirements.
- Achieved 8% (approximately $1M) in bill-of-materials savings within three months of taking over the account, through demand forecasting, cost analysis, and negotiation.
- Served as primary global contact for tariff impact analysis on semiconductors, raw materials, and end products; designed and maintained an HTS code database to evaluate current and projected tariff exposure.
- Built data capture frameworks to support allocation strategy and analysis of cost, price erosion, and supplier performance.
- Optimized $350K in uncategorized spend and eliminated 20 hours of manual work per week through cross-functional process improvements.
- Led annual business reviews with suppliers, measuring performance against KPIs and negotiating improved terms.

### Fusion Worldwide | September 2022 – May 2023

**Buyer** | Boston, MA

- Managed more than 100 vendor accounts and developed new supplier relationships to meet open-market demand during customer supply disruptions.
- Analyzed supply trends for specific commodity groups through market research with global colleagues, suppliers, and manufacturers.
- Sourced quotes for daily global customer demand and managed purchase orders, lead times, quality testing, and delivery schedules.
